text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum on the day (+2.3% vs +1.2%), suggesting traders are rotating toward the largest asset as risk appetite strengthens. The Fear & Greed index sits in Greed territory at 73 with a sharp 42-point weekly climb, reflecting a marked shift from caution to optimism across the market. BTC dominance holding near 59% and a healthy $125B in daily volume indicate sustained conviction rather than a thin rally.
